nootaikok.notes: Native1254 and200 viewed: strong visible painterly oil strokes replace photo, solemn ageless grave friendly face, two five-digit offering hands. Effortlessly upright underwater in deep dark glacier, one small far opening lights face/hands, three seals rise past hands, hunters on solidice. c01/c02/c03/c04 respected, no aura/icecontrol.
